content.short: Lemonade is an on-chain toolkit for creating events and running communities, with NFT ticketing.
content.description: Lemonade is an open platform for creators and brands to host in-person and virtual events and manage communities, with NFT ticketing, token-gated access, rewards and a gas-covered wallet for easy onboarding. Creators can set up their own Lemonade Stand to collaborate. Blockscout's World Chain app marketplace lists Lemonade.
content.meta: Lemonade is an on-chain events and community toolkit with NFT ticketing, listed for World Chain.
